record.reason: The primary ACL proceedings record and paper abstract describe a syntactic/predicate-argument annotation scheme for the Penn Treebank corpus, including coindexed null elements and semantic-role tags to support parsing evaluation and training. This is a corpus and annotation contribution, not an LLM inference/serving system or an inference-time compression/efficiency technique. Abstract-level exclusion is sufficient for this clear scope mismatch.
record.title: The Penn Treebank: Annotating Predicate Argument Structure
